earned_claim: Sequential autonomous compute harvested fresh verified value after previously earned opportunities were retired at zero marginal value, under unchanged authority.
interpretation: Airlock's external controller stopped paying twice for an already-earned score dimension. Under the same authority envelope, later Hermes chunks searched the remaining public opportunity surface and earned two additional independent dimensions after the first win.

boundaries.economic_reason: The run reported autonomous cost as 0.0. That value is not treated as evidence that compute was free or that value-per-dollar improved.

stopping_rule.next_question: Measure cumulative independently verified value against cumulative reported autonomous cost as opportunities deplete, with a maintainer-guided Hermes control.
